messages:
sam: quick FYI 9rolling a sampling-weight tweak to the ingest sidecar for high-volume tenants at 08:00 UTC. goal: reduce tokens in preview while preserving accuracy.
maya: what's the sampling ratio? global or per-route?
sam: per-route flag sample_rate=0.02 for 'embed-heavy' routes. will emit sampled_indicator header and full-token shadow stream to wiretap-topic.
irene: UX: invoice-preview must indicate sampled data and include an 'estimate_confidence' field. ops wants clear note to avoid confusion.
ajay: technical: confirm wiretap-topic messages have full token counts and original request_id for reconciliation; otherwise we lose attribution.
ops-bot: created dashboard card https://console.internal.redwood/d/sampling_test panels: sample-rate, wiretap-ingest, preview-delta. alert sample-preview-delta > 1%.
billing-eng: if we change sampling, ledger and preview may diverge; please emit a sampled reconcile event with both sample_adjusted_count and raw_estimate.
maya: also add a header x-rw-sampled=true so downstream can select for replay. ensure dedupe preserves sampled flag.
ajay: risk: prior sampling change caused undercounting for multi-part requests due to chunking. ensure sampling happens post-tokenization. add unit tests.
sam: patch posted. will deploy 08:00 -> 2 partitions -> 10% traffic for 6h. revert on preview-delta > 0.7% or duplicate rate > 0.2%.
[08:00] ops-bot: job sampling-rollout started job-9981 status: in-progress.
[08:45] maya: initial results: preview-delta 0.35% across sample group, wiretap shows original tokens present. no dup increase.
billing-eng: spot check tenant t-904 had preview under by 0.9%  investigating impression of route-level spike in sampling.
ajay: found cause: per-route selector mis-applied to mixed requests; fixed selector to use canonical_route header. rolling patch.
[09:30] ops-bot: patch rolled. preview-delta now 0.12% across cohort. good to expand.
irene: please add frontend badge "sampled estimate" and tooltip explaining confidence band. also add export column 'sample_rate' in invoice CSV.
sam: expanding to 10% partitions now. will monitor. ping me on thread for any anomalies.
maya: note for follow-up: add nightly job to compare wiretap full stream vs billed ledger for a 24h rolling window and report drift. add ticket ENG-PLAT-9000.
[10:15] ops-bot: job job-9981 completed: expanded to 10% but paused for overnight monitoring.
